changes_made.explanation: Removed 'English' as it's not a generated output language (Python code is generated). Consolidated model variants (Gemma 3 → Gemma 3 12b, GPT 4o-mini → GPT-4o-mini). Normalized output descriptions.
All metrics are correctly extracted and relevant. No normalization needed as metrics are already in standard form.
Removed redundant items and consolidated criteria. VLM Score is a metric name, not a method. Kept 'Readability' and 'Quality' as the main criteria.
No human evaluation was conducted. The paper explicitly uses automated evaluation methods only.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on automated EDA code generation using a RAG framework. It evaluates generated code using semantic accuracy (Recall@k), code reliability (Pass Rate@k), and visual quality (VLM Score). The extraction was generally accurate, requiring minor normalization of model names and consolidation of redundant items.
